title: Rest in Grace
description:
Welcome to Rest In Grace ✝️
Peaceful Bible readings for sleep, prayer, rest, and nightly devotion.

Every video is carefully crafted to help you fall asleep peacefully while listening to God’s Word. Each upload is thoughtfully structured around a specific biblical theme such as peace, protection, trust, healing, hope, spiritual rest, fear, anxiety, or God’s promises. Scripture selections, narration, animation, and ambience are intentionally brought together in every video to create a meaningful and immersive scripture experience.

On this channel you’ll find:
• Bible verses for sleep
• Peaceful Scripture reading
• Bedtime Bible stories and Psalms
• Soothing listening experiences for anxiety, stress, and rest

📖 “In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.” — Psalm 4:8
